rows.commentary: 0.1: Taskin Ahmed bounds in from over the wicket, dropping it short outside off to extract steep bounce that Brian Bennett watches sail through to the gloves.
0.2: Taskin Ahmed attacks the off-stump with another sharp, shortish delivery that Brian Bennett drives firmly on the up, picking out the fielder at short cover.
0.3: Taskin Ahmed digs it in short and wide, drawing a flashing blade from Brian Bennett that only slices through empty air.
0.4: Taskin Ahmed offers a fuller length that lures Brian Bennett into the drive, zipping past the outside edge to leave the batter still searching for his first run.
0.5: Taskin Ahmed tests the channel from a length, angling it in sharply as Brian Bennett offers no shot and watches it through to the keeper.
0.6: Taskin Ahmed traps Brian Bennett lbw for a duck after a review confirms the delivery clipped the top of the pad as the batter played down the wrong line.
1.1: Shoriful Islam attacks from over the wicket, dropping it slightly short around off stump as Ben Curran hangs deep in his crease to turn it firmly toward short square leg for a dot.
1.2: No run for Ben Curran off Shoriful Islam.
1.3: Shoriful Islam attacks the off-stump from back of a length, forcing Ben Curran to punch it solidly right back to the bowler for no run.
1.4: Shoriful Islam angles it across the channel and Ben Curran wisely offers no stroke.
1.5: Shoriful Islam targets the channel outside off with a sharp back-of-a-length delivery, inducing a hurried inside edge from Ben Curran that scurries down to fine leg for a single.
1.6: Dot ball from Shoriful Islam to Tafadzwa Tsiga.
2.1: Taskin Ahmed offers a fuller length angled sharply across, tempting Ben Curran into an ambitious drive that swings and misses completely.
2.2: Taskin Ahmed provides width with a fuller delivery, and Ben Curran leans gracefully into a stunning stroke, driving it through extra cover all the way to the boundary rope.
2.3: Taskin Ahmed searches down the leg side, allowing Ben Curran to clear his front foot and steer a single away toward deep fine leg.
2.4: Taskin Ahmed drives it on a length and nips it in, allowing Tafadzwa Tsiga to steer a single down to long leg.
2.5: Taskin Ahmed targets the pads, inducing Ben Curran to turn it straight toward square leg for a dot.
2.6: Taskin Ahmed attacks the stumps on a length, leaving Ben Curran with no room to maneuver.
3.1: Dot ball from Shoriful Islam to Tafadzwa Tsiga.
3.2: Shoriful Islam fires it into the pads, and Tafadzwa Tsiga deftly tickles it away to the fine leg boundary.
3.3: Shoriful Islam darts one onto the pads, and Tafadzwa Tsiga calmly nudges it straight into the hands at mid-on.
3.4: Shoriful Islam digs it in short down the leg side, and Tafadzwa Tsiga whips out a fine pull that races away to the boundary.
3.5: Shoriful Islam shifts his length tightly to off-stump, inviting Tafadzwa Tsiga to push it firmly towards cover-point for a dot ball.
3.6: Shoriful Islam fires the fuller length dart angled into the stumps, and Tafadzwa Tsiga brings the bat down sharply, skewing a cue-end drive past mid-off to scamper back for two brisk runs.
4.1: Taskin Ahmed strikes with the angle, pinning Ben Curran plumb in front to trap the batsman lbw for six.
4.2: Taskin Ahmed digs it in short outside off, guided gently toward cover point as Brendan Taylor scampers through for a sharp single.
4.3: Taskin Ahmed hits a back-of-a-length delivery that swerves sharply away across off stump, leaving Tafadzwa Tsiga squared up and smartly abandoning the stroke at the very last moment.
4.4: Taskin Ahmed digs this short of a length outside off, extracting seam movement away as Tafadzwa Tsiga wisely withdraws his bat.
4.5: Taskin Ahmed overcompensates with a fuller offering, and Tafadzwa Tsiga leans into a serene drive through extra cover for four.
4.6: Taskin Ahmed presses in at a length, and Tafadzwa Tsiga gets firmly behind the line to block it securely into the off-side.
5.1: Shoriful Islam comes over the wicket with a shortish delivery angling across off, and Brendan Taylor watches it sail past.
5.2: No run for Brendan Taylor off Shoriful Islam.
5.3: Shoriful Islam attacks with a full and straight delivery, met by the veteran resolve of Brendan Taylor who punches it firmly back to the bowler for no score.
5.4: Shoriful Islam targets the length, and Brendan Taylor stays back to push the ball straight back to the bowler.
5.5: Shoriful Islam attacks outside off with a fuller delivery that Brendan Taylor calmly plays right back down the pitch.
5.6: Shoriful Islam serves it full outside off, prompting Brendan Taylor to step forward and punch the ball firmly toward extra cover.
6.1: Taskin Ahmed digs it in short at the body, and Tafadzwa Tsiga answers with a sharp wristy flick into the midwicket pocket for a single.
6.2: Taskin Ahmed offers a fuller length outside off, clipped straight into the hands of mid-off by Brendan Taylor.
6.3: Taskin Ahmed pitches full into the stumps, calmly pushed back down the pitch by Brendan Taylor.
6.4: Taskin Ahmed angles one in at waist height, and Brendan Taylor tucks it down to long leg to rotate the strike.
6.5: Taskin Ahmed pitches it short and wide of off, where Tafadzwa Tsiga slices a drive toward Rishad at backward point.
6.6: Taskin Ahmed strikes right at the death of the powerplay, drawing the edge from Tafadzwa Tsiga as Nurul Hasan pouches the catch behind the stumps.
7.1: Shoriful Islam attacks with a full delivery, met by the defensive prod of Brendan Taylor.
7.2: Shoriful Islam delivers on a length angling across, allowing Brendan Taylor to watch it through to the keeper.
7.3: Dot ball from Shoriful Islam to Brendan Taylor.
7.4: Shoriful Islam attacks the channel outside off, angling it into Brendan Taylor who pushes firmly towards the midwicket fielder crouching inside the ring.
7.5: Shoriful Islam pitches it up outside off channel, and Brendan Taylor shuffles across to watch it sail past safely into the gloves.
7.6: Shoriful Islam offers width, and Brendan Taylor punishes it with a fierce square cut that screams away to the boundary.

8.1: Taskin Ahmed steams in to deliver from over the wicket, dropping it back of a length just outside off stump, allowing Ervine to spring onto the back foot and punch it crisply to cover inside the circle.
8.2: Taskin Ahmed pushes this full delivery wide of off stump, and Ervine stabs it firmly into the turf toward mid-on.
8.3: Taskin Ahmed angles this back-of-a-length delivery into middle, inducing Ervine to tuck it safely across to square leg.
8.4: Taskin Ahmed drops the pace into the ribs, forcing Ervine to tuck it safely toward square leg.
8.5: Taskin Ahmed angles one across the off-stump, and Ervine dead-bats it down toward mid-off with absolute caution.
8.6: Taskin Ahmed rips one back off a length, zinging past Craig Ervine's inside edge as the batter tries to punch it through the off-side.
9.1: Mustafizur Rahman steams in and drops it on a length, cutting sharply across Brendan Taylor who watches it through to the keeper without offering a shot.
9.2: Mustafizur Rahman floats a fuller delivery on middle and leg, calmly nudged by Brendan Taylor straight to the mid-wicket fielder.
9.3: Mustafizur Rahman extracts sharp movement off the seam, zipping past Brendan Taylor's outside edge in another probing examination.
9.4: Mustafizur Rahman drops it slightly back on middle, allowing Brendan Taylor to whip it into the vacant spaces of deep square leg for two comfortable runs.
9.5: Mustafizur Rahman locks it in near the off-stump, and Brendan Taylor pushes across the line straight to midwicket.
9.6: Mustafizur Rahman drops it fractionally short outside off, yielding only a swiped connection down to mid-off from Brendan Taylor.
10.1: Taskin Ahmed comes from around the wicket, angling a fuller delivery in from outside off that Ervine drives cleanly back into the bowler's hands for a dot.
10.2: Taskin Ahmed offers width, and Ervine pounces from the crease, dispatching the loose delivery through backward point for a crisp boundary.
10.3: Taskin Ahmed tests Ervine with a sharp delivery angled on a back of a length outside off, successfully inducing a defensive push into the off side.
10.4: Taskin Ahmed feeds it into the length, angling in sharply, and Ervine plays a quiet wristy tuck into the mid-wicket region to rotate the strike.
10.5: Taskin Ahmed locks onto a probing length outside off, offering Brendan Taylor nothing as the ball zips through untouched.
10.6: Brendan Taylor does not score off Taskin Ahmed.
11.1: Mustafizur Rahman drops it slightly back, and Ervine opens the bat-face to steer the ball away to deep third man for a comfortable single.
11.2: Mustafizur Rahman targets the stumps on a back-of-a-length delivery, prompting Brendan Taylor to crouch and push it solidly straight back to the bowler.
11.3: No run for Brendan Taylor off Mustafizur Rahman.
11.4: Mustafizur Rahman offers the length, and Brendan Taylor sits deep in the crease, lashing it straight down the ground to split the long-on and long-off cushion for four.
11.5: Mustafizur Rahman floats it full with width, and Brendan Taylor shuffles across his stumps to larrup it over the top and race away to long-on.
11.6: Mustafizur Rahman targets the channel to Brendan Taylor, who dabs the ball softly toward short third man to rotate the strike.
12.1: Shoriful Islam comes over the wicket, dropping it short into the batter's ribs as Brendan Taylor works it neatly around the corner down to long leg for a single.
12.2: Shoriful Islam hits a back of a length outside off stump, allowing Ervine to ride the bounce and guide it softly away to deep backward point.
12.3: Shoriful Islam delivers to Brendan Taylor, who effortlessly steers the ball past the fielder at third man for a crisp boundary.
12.4: Shoriful Islam comes around the wicket to Brendan Taylor, dropping it short on off-stump to draw a dead-bat defence back down the pitch.
12.5: Shoriful Islam offers width outside off and Brendan Taylor seizes the room, carving a fierce slap that eludes a clumsy chase from the deep cover fielder to race away for four.
12.6: Shoriful Islam sends one down to Brendan Taylor, who guides it deftly toward third man to comfortably collect a pair of runs.
13.1: Mosaddek Hossain drifts one into leg from round the wicket, enticing Craig Ervine to shift leg-side and push-drive firmly toward cover with a lone slip waiting.

13.2: Mosaddek Hossain drifts it through at eighty-seven point four kilometers per hour, serving up a generously full delivery that Craig Ervine tracks cleanly, driving it firmly along the turf toward long-off to collect a single.
13.3: Mosaddek fires in an 85.8kph flat length ball targeting the off-stump, keeping Brendan Taylor securely locked in his crease with no run on offer.
13.4: Mosaddek returns to his task as Brendan Taylor quickly adjusts with a rapid reverse-sweep, jamming his bat down just in time to keep the ball from ballooning.
13.5: Mosaddek Hossain goes around the wicket to pitch it full on middle, and Ervine solidly dead-bats the ball straight towards mid-on for no run.
13.6: Mosaddek Hossain attacks the middle stump on a good length, and Ervine strokes it down to long-off for a comfortable single to close out the over.
14.1: Mustafizur Rahman drops it short of a length, and Ervine dead-bats the ball firmly into the off-side.
14.2: Mustafizur Rahman offers width outside off, Ervine flashes hard and drags an under-edge rolling away to third man for a single.
14.3: Mustafizur Rahman digs it in on a short of length targeting middle, leaving Brendan Taylor no room to work with as he defends into the pitch.
14.4: Mustafizur Rahman charges in from over the wicket, hammering a 132.1kph length delivery straight into the stumps that Brendan Taylor gently steers toward midwicket.
14.5: Mustafizur Rahman keeps the pressure dialed right up to the maximum, foxing Brendan Taylor with a clever slower yorker that the batter hurriedly digs out toward point for no run.
14.6: Mustafizur Rahman floats it up at 132.9kph, drawing Brendan Taylor forward to guide the fuller delivery sharply towards backward point for a dot.
15.1: Mosaddek Hossain drops it short on middle, allowing Ervine to clear his front leg and pull it disdainfully into the long-on gap for four.
15.2: Mosaddek Hossain attacks the stumps with a full delivery, which Ervine calmly strokes down to long-off for a single.
15.3: Mosaddek Hossain serves it full outside off, and Brendan Taylor gets forward decisively to dead-bat the delivery.
15.4: Mosaddek Hossain attacks the stumps on a good length, prompting Taylor to plant his front foot and steer the ball toward mid-on.
15.5: Mosaddek Hossain strays too straight, allowing Brendan Taylor to whip it away to the backward square leg boundary.
15.6: Mosaddek Hossain delivers to Brendan Taylor, who punches the ball cleanly through extra cover to collect a brace.
16.1: Mustafizur Rahman drops it short of a length, and Ervine nudges it neatly toward midwicket where Sarkar flashes across to execute a brilliant fielding stop.
16.2: Mustafizur Rahman drops it short, finding Ervine who launches the pull directly into the waiting hands of midwicket.
16.3: Mustafizur Rahman fires it full and wide of off stump, expertly smothered right back down the pitch by Ervine.
16.4: Mustafizur Rahman rolls his fingers across a slower delivery down the leg side, beating Ervine's frantic attempt to glance.
16.5: Mustafizur Rahman snaps one back off a length, completely foxing Ervine as the drive finds only empty air and whistles past the timber.
16.6: Mustafizur Rahman fires it in full at one-thirty-one kilometers per hour from wide on the crease, met solidly by Ervine who pats it straight down the pitch.
17.1: Mosaddek Hossain fires it flat and straight, catching Brendan Taylor sliding a wristy push directly toward short midwicket where Shanto dives sharply to parry it away.
17.2: Mosaddek Hossain pins Brendan Taylor on the reverse-sweep, but DRS exposes an impact well outside off-stump after a frantic late referral from Bangladesh.
17.3: Mosaddek Hossain darts this length delivery straight into Brendan Taylor, who clips it firmly towards short midwicket.
17.4: Mosaddek Hossain tosses this full delivery up to Brendan Taylor, who punches it smoothly down the ground to collect a single at long-on.
17.5: Mosaddek Hossain floats it into Ervine, who strides forward to push it safely away.
17.6: Mosaddek Hossain floats it up, and Ervine advances down the pitch to push the ball down to long-off for a single.
18.1: Mustafizur Rahman floats the slower cutter outside off at 124.6kph, allowing Ervine to steer it cleanly down to third man for a comfortable single.
18.2: Mustafizur Rahman pitches it back of a length into the ribs, leaving Brendan Taylor just enough room to glance it away toward fine leg for a single.
18.3: Ervine does not score off Mustafizur Rahman.
18.4: Mustafizur Rahman fires in a skiddy length delivery angling sharply toward the stumps, catching Ervine on the hop as he nudges it straight to midwicket.
18.5: Mustafizur Rahman floats it up, and Ervine manipulates the angle brilliantly, angling the bat down to pierce the gap at mid-wicket with a sumptuous wristy flick for four.
18.6: Mustafizur Rahman floats an off-pace full ball into Ervine, who dead-bats it solidly from the crease.
19.1: Rishad Hossain drops a flighted low full toss towards Brendan Taylor with a slip waiting, nudged away cleanly down to long-off for a single.
19.2: Rishad Hossain drifts a fuller legbreak into Ervine, who sweeps it away fine with soft hands to hustle back for a comfortable couple.
19.3: Rishad Hossain floats up a full toss on the leg stump, and Ervine turns it away toward deep midwicket to collect a single.

19.4: Rishad Hossain drops a dipping full toss on Brendan Taylor, who sinks low to attempt the reverse-sweep but meets only thin air, sparking a half-hearted LBW appeal that fails to convince the umpire.
19.5: Rishad Hossain drops it short to Brendan Taylor who hangs back for the pull, missing entirely as the ball glances off the pad toward backward square leg for a leg bye.
19.6: Rishad Hossain darts a quicker length ball just outside the off stump, safely steered through point by Ervine for a single to close the over.
20.1: Mosaddek Hossain delivers a flat eighty-seven kph ball, punched firmly by Ervine toward long-off for a single as the floodlights begin to take effect.
20.2: Mosaddek Hossain fires in a full eighty-nine point one kph delivery, neatly clipped by Brendan Taylor straight to midwicket.
20.3: Mosaddek Hossain sends down an eighty-eight point seven kph full ball, and Taylor shuffles away early to whip it toward deep square leg for one.
20.4: No run for Ervine off Mosaddek Hossain.
20.5: Mosaddek Hossain drifts one slightly short outside off, allowing Ervine to rock back and slice a single down to deep point.

20.6: Mosaddek Hossain arrows in a deceptive yorker from over the wicket that completely flummoxes Brendan Taylor, beating everything including the keeper as it flashes millimetres past the leg stump.
21.1: Rishad Hossain drops it short on middle, and Ervine springs onto the back foot to flick a single away toward midwicket.
21.2: Rishad Hossain floats the legbreak up to Brendan Taylor, who strides forward to push it safely into the cover ring.
21.3: Rishad Hossain tosses it just outside off, allowing Brendan Taylor to sweep hard towards backward square leg for a single.
21.4: Rishad Hossain keeps it tight as Ervine guides the ball towards sweeper cover to collect another single.
21.5: No run for Brendan Taylor off Rishad Hossain.
21.6: Rishad Hossain floats it up full to Brendan Taylor, who shifts leg-side and punches the ball down to long-off for a straightforward single.
22.1: Mosaddek Hossain serves up a full length to Brendan Taylor, clipped neatly through square leg to hustle back for two runs.
22.2: Mosaddek Hossain drops it short and wide, allowing Brendan Taylor to carve it effortlessly away to the sweeper cover boundary.
22.3: Mosaddek Hossain floats this slower delivery full and outside off, angling it in as Brendan Taylor commits to a flick across the line straight to midwicket.
22.4: Mosaddek Hossain pushes it full into middle, and Brendan Taylor works it neatly around the corner to bring up the team century for Zimbabwe.

22.5: Mosaddek Hossain fires one straying down leg as Ervine's sweeping flick fails to connect, leaving him off balance while the keeper whips the bails off to trigger a television review that ultimately confirms his ground.
22.5: Mosaddek Hossain drifts this one into middle and leg, where Ervine defends it softly out toward midwicket.
22.6: Mosaddek Hossain tosses it up full, allowing Ervine to stroke it down to long-off for a single.
23.1: Rishad Hossain floats up a full leg-break at eighty-three point four kilometers per hour, inviting Ervine forward to nudge it toward midwicket.
23.2: Rishad Hossain floats it up full on leg, and Ervine unfurls a sharp reverse sweep out to deep point for a single.
23.3: Rishad Hossain zips one through with a flatter trajectory, allowing Brendan Taylor to punch it cleanly down to long-on.
23.4: Rishad Hossain offers a full, tossed-up delivery that Ervine steps into, adjusts leg-side to turn into a half-volley, and thumps straight back over the bowler's head for four.
23.5: Rishad Hossain fires in a full delivery clocked at eighty-eight point two kilometers per hour, safely defended by Ervine.
23.6: Rishad Hossain rounds off the over as Ervine works a single away square of the wicket.
24.1: Soumya Sarkar sends down an innocuous full delivery angled into leg, which Ervine effortlessly clips into the deep midwicket region for a single.
24.2: Brendan Taylor shuffles across to a full offering and nudges it toward deep square leg, collecting the single that brings up a magnificent and thoroughly deserved 40th ODI half-century.
24.3: Soumya Sarkar delivers a length ball at 116.4kph, and Ervine works it away cleanly toward deep backward square leg to rotate the strike.
24.4: Soumya Sarkar drops it short, Brendan Taylor creates room to punch through cover-point as a fumble allows the single.
24.5: Soumya Sarkar delivers a length ball that Ervine nudges away toward deep square leg for one.
24.6: Soumya Sarkar serves up a length delivery, and Brendan Taylor pushes it firmly toward the cover fielder.
25.1: Rishad Hossain drops it full through the air, and Ervine uses soft wrists to turn it away into the leg-side for a single.
25.2: Rishad Hossain spears this length delivery into Brendan Taylor, who lunges forward, gets an inside edge off the push, and scrambles a run toward midwicket.
25.3: Rishad Hossain switches around the wicket to toss up a looping full ball, and Ervine drills it cleanly along the carpet down to long-on.
25.4: Rishad Hossain slides this full delivery outside off, and Brendan Taylor executes a sublime sweep, scorching the ball away into the backward square leg boundary.
25.5: Rishad Hossain floats it up to Brendan Taylor, who carves an exquisite inside-out drive over the infield to bring up a magnificent hundred-run partnership.
25.6: Rishad Hossain drops one in around off to Brendan Taylor, who reads the spin and safely pats it straight back to the bowler.
26.1: Soumya Sarkar comes from round the wicket and sprays it too wide to Ervine.
26.1: Soumya Sarkar offers width, and Ervine punches it cleanly toward sweeper cover to scamper through for a brisk single.
26.2: Brendan Taylor finds the boundary off Soumya Sarkar for four.
26.3: Soumya Sarkar offers width, and Brendan Taylor waits patiently to steer the cut away toward sweeper cover for a single.
26.4: Soumya Sarkar floats down a gentle 100.7kph full delivery, which Ervine smoothly caresses through point for one run.
26.5: Soumya Sarkar angles one in on a good length as Brendan Taylor steps forward, turning the face of the bat to nudge it through midwicket for a brace.
26.6: Soumya Sarkar drops it full, and Brendan Taylor strides forward to dead-bat it firmly onto the turf.
27.1: Rishad Hossain floats one up outside off from round the wicket, and Ervine plays the reverse-sweep straight into the hands of short third man.
27.2: Rishad Hossain drops it on a length and extracts sharp spin back in, cramping Ervine as he retreats deep to dab it away on the off-side.
27.3: Rishad Hossain tosses this one up on a length into middle, allowing Ervine to step back and nudge it down to long-on for a single.
27.4: Rishad Hossain drifts it down leg at eighty-three point six kilometres per hour, and Taylor glances a gentle single down toward fine leg.
27.5: Rishad Hossain drops in a low full toss, answered by an inventive reverse-sweep from Ervine that squeezes past a fumbling Taskin Ahmed at short third man for one.

27.6: Rishad Hossain floats it full outside off at eighty-eight point five kilometers per hour, inviting Brendan Taylor to shuffle across, sink low, and swipe the delivery out to long-on for a single.
28.1: Shoriful Islam delivers a back-of-length ball angled inward, allowing Brendan Taylor to play it late with a delicate dab toward third man.
28.2: Shoriful Islam steams in to clock 131.9kph, forcing Ervine to react quickly and nurdle away a single.
28.3: Brendan Taylor does not score off Shoriful Islam.
28.4: Shoriful Islam charges in from wide of the crease, digging it short into the middle-stump line before Brendan Taylor whips it firmly past the midwicket ring for a single.
28.5: Shoriful Islam attacks off-stump from over the wicket, catching Ervine on the crease to absorb the length.
28.6: Shoriful Islam digs it in short, and Ervine rides the bounce to whip it firmly toward the deep square leg boundary for a single.
29.1: Rishad Hossain drops it very full, prompting Ervine to sweep hard as Shanto sprints and dives in the deep to save two.
29.2: Rishad Hossain floats it full, and Craig Ervine strokes it cleanly to long-on to notch up his 26th ODI half-century.
29.3: Rishad Hossain darts this one into the pads, allowing Brendan Taylor to tuck it toward mid-wicket and scamper through for a quick single.
29.4: Rishad tosses it up full on the legs, and Ervine wrists it away into the deep midwicket grass for a comfortable single.
29.5: Brendan Taylor drops to one knee against Rishad, sweeping powerfully toward deep backward square leg to rotate the strike.
29.6: Rishad Hossain drops a ripping legbreak on a length that beats Ervine, drawing a loud shout for lbw that the umpire waves away and Bangladesh wisely leave alone.
30.1: Shoriful Islam fires it in at one hundred thirty-four point one kilometers per hour, clamping down on the pads for Brendan Taylor to glance away to fine leg for a single.
30.2: Shoriful Islam charges in at one hundred twenty-nine point seven kilometers per hour, sliding it past Ervine as he nudges the delivery toward deep backward square leg to rotate the strike.
30.3: Dot ball from Shoriful Islam to Brendan Taylor.
30.4: Shoriful Islam attacks from wide of the crease around the wicket, extracting extra bounce and pace to zip past Brendan Taylor's flailing outside edge.
30.5: Shoriful Islam angles it in from wide of the crease, sliding a short delivery into the pads that Brendan Taylor clips away smoothly toward deep backward square leg for a single.
30.6: Shoriful Islam digs in a sharp bumper outside off, and Ervine swats it away comfortably to deep midwicket to pick up a single as the players gather for a drinks break.
31.1: Mustafizur Rahman targets the pads with a full angle, clipping it straight to a sharp midwicket fielder inside the ring.
31.2: Mustafizur Rahman deceives Ervine with a slower full delivery drifting down leg, catching the batter far too early on the flick.
31.3: Mustafizur Rahman floats a 126.1kph length delivery angling toward off, and Ervine cushions it softly into the off-side before aborting the run.
31.4: Mustafizur Rahman fires it in from over the wicket with a slower leg-cutter outside off, prompting Ervine to steer it toward a ring fielder at third man after a hesitant advance.
31.5: Mustafizur Rahman snaps off a sharp bouncer that sails over Ervine's ducking helmet, completing five consecutive dots.
31.6: Mustafizur Rahman angles from wide of the crease with a clever slower delivery, driven firmly by Ervine straight to cover to seal a maiden.
32.1: Shoriful Islam attacks from around the wicket, forcing Brendan Taylor to deliberately steer the shorter delivery into the channel for a single.

32.2: Shoriful Islam angles it in, Ervine shuffles across to flick and misses, and though the umpire raises the finger after a delayed appeal, DRS rescues the batter with ball-tracking showing it sailing just over the middle stump.
32.3: Shoriful Islam pitches short of a good length, angling in for Ervine to clip it in front of square and scamper back for a swift second.
32.4: Shoriful Islam digs it in short of a good length around off, and Ervine wrists it cleanly into the vacant turf wide of mid-wicket to hustle back for a comfortable second run.
32.5: Shoriful Islam keeps it back of a length, worked away by Ervine to deep square leg for a single.
32.6: Shoriful Islam darts one in, pushed by Brendan Taylor towards backward square leg to rotate the strike.
33.1: Mustafizur Rahman floats it up slower and fuller on middle and off, angling across the crease as Brendan Taylor dead-bats it straight to the cover fielder.
33.2: Mustafizur Rahman digs it in short across the right-hander, and Brendan Taylor ducks beneath the trajectory with calculated ease.
33.3: Mustafizur Rahman unleashes another fierce bumper that climbs well over Brendan Taylor, drawing the wide signal from the umpire.
33.3: Mustafizur Rahman rolls his fingers over the ball for a clever slower cutter, and Brendan Taylor pats it gently into the off-side before aborting a hasty single.
33.4: Mustafizur Rahman deceives Brendan Taylor with a slower off-cutter that bounces through to the keeper.
33.5: Mustafizur Rahman digs it in short of a good length outside off, cramping Taylor on the pull shot straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
33.6: Mustafizur Rahman finishes the over with a sharp delivery angled toward off, where Taylor clears his front leg only to lash it directly to the man stationed at midwicket.
34.1: Mosaddek Hossain drops a generous full-toss into the arc, and Ervine drops to one knee to sweep it ruthlessly behind square for four.
34.2: Mosaddek Hossain drops it slightly short outside off, allowing Ervine to carve a sharp square punch into the off-side for a quick single.
34.3: Mosaddek Hossain tosses this one up on off stump, inviting Brendan Taylor to stroke it straight down to long-on for an easy single.
34.4: Mosaddek Hossain delivers to Ervine, who collects a single out in the deep towards extra cover.
34.5: Mosaddek Hossain tosses it up as Brendan Taylor crouches low for the paddle, picking out the fielder stationed at short fine leg.
34.6: Mosaddek Hossain drifts one in, catching Taylor's inside edge on the attempted flick to loop safely toward short third man.
35.1: Taskin Ahmed steams in from over the wicket, dropping back of a length to allow Brendan Taylor a simple single into the mid-wicket region.
